The seven provided input parameters include three length-like measures (Ra, kt, k_rms) and four purely statistical or geometric, dimensionless descriptors (Sk, Ku, ES, Po). By Buckingham Pi, the target dimensionless group ks/Ra can only depend on dimensionless combinations of the inputs; length inputs must appear in nondimensional ratios (e.g., kt/Ra, k_rms/Ra) while the purely dimensionless inputs (Sk, Ku, ES, Po) may appear directly. Therefore the governing relation can be written in nondimensional form ks/Ra = F(kt/Ra, k_rms/Ra, Sk, Ku, ES, Po). This reasoning assumes classical SI base dimensions and that all supplied statistical descriptors (Sk, Ku, ES, Po) are dimensionless by construction.

variables.physical_definition: First-order absolute moment of surface height fluctuations (mean absolute deviation of height from the mean).
Peak-to-valley height of the rough surface (maximum vertical distance between highest peak and deepest valley).

the root-mean-square height, k_rms;
the skewness of roughness height fluctuations, Sk;
the kurtosis of roughness height fluctuations, Ku;
the effective streamwise slope of the roughness, ES;
